title: Facts say when they were true, and a pack answers as of a date or a release
goal: A fact line can carry a validity window (true from, true until) beside its tag, and a CODE fact the commit range it holds for; rag.py pack and kb_pack take an as-of date and answer with the facts valid then, saying which they left out; a refresh closes a changed fact with an end date and adds the new one instead of rewriting it, so the kb's history stays answerable without re-research.
